description: This file implements quantized convolution operations for XPU using oneDNN in the PyTorch framework, including functions for prepacking, running pointwise convolutions, and handling binary operations, with registration for the onednn library.

classes.name: QConvoneDNNXPU
classes.description: Class implementing quantized convolution operations for XPU using oneDNN.

methods.name: qconv_decide_out_dtype
methods.description: Decides the output data type for quantized convolution based on input tensor and optional output dtype.

methods.name: qconv_prepack_xpu
methods.description: Prepares the weight tensor for convolution, currently returns the weight as is.

methods.name: run_pointwise
methods.description: Executes a pointwise quantized convolution with optional post-operations.

methods.name: run_pointwise_tensor
methods.description: Executes a pointwise quantized convolution using tensor inputs for scale and zero point.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Executes a binary post-operation quantized convolution, e.g., sum or sum with ReLU.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary_tensor
methods.description: Executes a binary post-operation quantized convolution with tensor inputs.
